children: Henry Schein entered into a Fourth Amended and Restated Revolving Credit Agreement, increasing its revolving commitments from $1.0 billion to $1.25 billion and extending the termination date to September 19, 2031. The facility, led by JPMorgan Chase Bank as administrative agent with a syndicate of lenders, will support working capital and general corporate purposes, including capital expenditures, share repurchases, permitted debt refinancing, and potential acquisitions. The agreement includes customary covenants and events of default.
: Fourth Amended and Restated unsecured revolving credit facility
: JPMorgan Chase Bank and a syndicate of lenders
: Enhance liquidity for operations, buybacks, refinancing, and acquisitions

title: Henry Schein Expands Revolving Credit Facility to $1.25 Billion, Extends Maturity to 2031
